units.source_text: 照子把丈夫送走之后，邀请姐姐在长火盆对面坐下，给姐姐沏了茶。

en.t: Teruko saw her husband off, then invited her elder sister to sit across from the long hibachi and made tea for her.

units.source_text: 她好像也很多开心的话题，诸如邻居太太的事、访问记者的事、还有和俊吉一同去看外国歌剧团的事等等。

en.t: She seemed to have plenty of cheerful topics too: the neighbor's wife, the visiting reporter, and going with Shunkichi to see a foreign opera troupe, among other things.

units.source_text: 信子却心绪不加，等她自己意识到的时候，才注意到原来自己一直心不在焉。

en.t: Nobuko, however, felt out of sorts, and only when she became aware of it herself did she realize she had been absent-minded all along.

units.source_text: 但自己是为什么这样，信子自己也搞不清楚。

en.t: But even Nobuko herself could not tell why she was that way.
